# Best travel charger with multiple USB-C ports

**Top pick: UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN charger.** Several reviewers name it the best for most travelers. It has three USB-C ports and one USB-A port, and either of the first two USB-C ports can deliver the full 100W alone. Power splits when you plug in more devices:
- Two devices: 65W + 30W
- All four ports: 45W, 30W and 10.5W on the remaining ports

That's enough for a laptop, a phone and earbuds overnight. It's the heaviest of the three chargers TechWise compared, at 8.3 oz, and no cable is included.

- Review with buy button: [TechWise, best GaN chargers for travel](https://www.techwisereviews.com/posts/best-gan-usb-c-chargers-travel-2026)
- Also listed in: [TechWise, multi-device picks](https://www.techwisereviews.com/posts/best-usb-c-chargers-travel-multiple-devices-2026) and [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/best-usb-c-phone-charger)

One source (VoyageHacks) describes it as four USB-C ports. TechWise and Android Central both say three USB-C plus one USB-A, so check the listing before you buy.

## Other options

- **Anker Prime 67W (2 USB-C + 1 USB-A):** Best if you want it small. It weighs 4.78 oz, and either USB-C port can deliver the full 67W alone. [TechWise](https://www.techwisereviews.com/posts/best-gan-usb-c-chargers-travel-2026), [VoyageHacks](https://voyagehacks.com/en/travel-gear/best-gan-wall-chargers-for-travel/)
- **Anker 737 120W (2 USB-C + 1 USB-A):** Best if a power-hungry laptop is your priority. [TechWise](https://www.techwisereviews.com/posts/best-usb-c-chargers-travel-multiple-devices-2026)
- **Anker 140W 4-port bundle (3 USB-C + 1 USB-A):** Best for heavy loads. It comes with a 240W cable. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/best-usb-c-phone-charger)
- **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W (2 USB-C + 1 USB-A):** Best value. It's sold as a 2-pack for $49.99 at Baseus's US store (as of 2026-10-21), and it has PPS for Samsung Galaxy phones. With multiple devices connected, the laptop port drops to 45W. [Buy at Baseus (via Dealectric, affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u)
- **Epicka TA-105 Max 75W (3 USB-C + 2 USB-A):** Best if you travel abroad. It has built-in swappable plugs, so you don't need a separate adapter. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/best-usb-adapter-for-travel)

## Tips

- Plug your laptop into the strongest USB-C port first, then add the other devices.
- Chargers rated over 60W need a 5A, e-marked USB-C cable to deliver full power.
- The wall chargers above have US plugs. Outside the US you'll need a plug adapter, not a voltage converter, unless you choose a universal model like the Epicka.
